_meta.note: AI-generated (Claude Code) during the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 hackathon. Only the pm role edits this file.
_meta.how_to_read: Each role pushes only to its own branch and edits only the paths it owns. Everything else goes through a request (see coord/README.md).

pm.does: Project lead and integrator. Product-side AI outputs (investigation cards, scenarios, ranking). Demo and submission text.

data.does: PSI data collection and the spec-driven pipeline: standard variables, fire-safety information needs, capability matrix.

ui.does: The dashboard: screens, output format, deployment to a public URL.

single_writer_coordination_files.coord/requests/<id>.md: written by the requester (the <from> part of the id)
